remarks: ASKING FOR HIGHEST & BEST OFFERS BY 12 NOON, MONDAY, APRIL 27th.Prime end-unit two-bedroom residence in the highly sought-after Wilton Crest community, ideally located just steps from convenient parking. This bright, move-in ready home offers exceptional privacy and abundant natural light throughout. The living room and both bedrooms feature sliding doors that open to a private patio overlooking beautifully manicured gardens and lawn, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor setting perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The interior showcases beautiful laminate flooring throughout the living space, complemented by elegant granite countertops and modern stainless-steel appliances in the kitchen. The thoughtfully designed layout balances comfort and functionality for effortless everyday living. Residents enjoy resort-style amenities, including a swimming pool and tennis court, all within a walkable setting close to downtown Wilton, nearby scenic trails and Schenck's Island. Additional highlights include private storage space and brand-new smart laundry units in the community basement, professional management, and easy commuter access. A rare opportunity for effortless, low-maintenance living in one of Fairfield County's most desirable communities-offering the charm of a true New England town. Arguably one of the best values currently available in Wilton - come experience it for yourself. ASKING FOR HIGHEST & BEST OFFERS BY 12 NOON, MONDAY, APRIL 27th.
